preconditions.description: The number of commands n must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in ['&', '|', '^'] for c in commands)
preconditions.description: Each command must be one of the valid bitwise operations: AND, OR, or XOR.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 1023 for x in constants)
preconditions.description: Each constant x must be a non-negative integer between 0 and 1023.

postconditions.description: The output program length k must be between 0 and 5.

postconditions.expression: all(c in ['&', '|', '^'] for c in output_commands)
postconditions.description: Each command in the output must be one of the valid bitwise operations: AND, OR, or XOR.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 1023 for x in output_constants)
postconditions.description: Each constant in the output must be a non-negative integer between 0 and 1023.
